create_actor_model: create an ActorModel with belief size, state size, hidden size, and action size parameters
get_action_distribution: get the action distribution from an ActorModel given a latent state or tensor input
sample_action: sample a stochastic or deterministic action from an ActorModel using get_action
create_sample_dist: create a SampleDist wrapper around a PyTorch distribution to estimate mean, mode, and entropy via sampling
review_actor_forward: review the ActorModel forward pass that outputs action mean and standard deviation from input tensors
